sections.name: Path to Glory
sections.text: Here, you will find additional rules to use with a Maggotkin of Nurgle army while playing through a Path to Glory campaign. The Path to Glory content in this book is divided into two parts: the Anvil of Apotheosis and Paths for Maggotkin of Nurgle units.

sections.name: The Anvil of Apotheosis
sections.text:
You can have 1 Anvil of Apotheosis hero on your Order of Battle and/ or army roster, unless otherwise specified in the battlepack you are using. They can be your warlord.
There are 7 steps to follow to create your hero:
1.Set a destiny point limit.
2.Fill out the starting warscroll.
3.Choose an Archetype.
4.Pick your hero’s origin and/or flaw.
5.Choose a Battle Mount.
6.Pick any Battle Mount Upgrades.
7.Pick any other upgrades.

sections.name: Step 1 - Set a Destiny Point Limit
sections.text:
The Anvil of Apotheosis uses a currency called destiny points. First, you need to set a destiny point limit. This will determine how many destiny points you have to spend on your hero, what type of hero they will be and what their battle profile points cost will be.
Pick 1 of the following:
HERO TYPE | DESTINY POINT LIMIT | BATTLE PROFILE POINTS COST
Blightpest | 10 | 150
Progenitor of Pollution | 30 | 250
Lord of Decay | 50 | 350
Over the next few steps, you will pick options for your hero. Each option has a destiny point cost, abbreviated as DP. Keep a record of the number of destiny points you have spent. You cannot exceed the limit you have set.

sections.text: To begin with, your hero has the following warscroll:

sections.name: Step 3 - Choose an Archetype
sections.text:
You must pick 1 of the following Archetypes for your hero:
Revolting Acolyte
-0DP
Your hero has the ROTBRINGERS keyword and the following regiment options:
Regiment Options | Any ROTBRINGERS units
Priest of Corruption
-4DP
Your hero has the ROTBRINGERS and PRIEST (1) keywords and the following regiment options:
Regiment Options | Any ROTBRINGERS units
Infected Warrior
-4DP
Your hero has the ROTBRINGERS keyword and the following regiment options:
Regiment Options | Any ROTBRINGERS units
In addition, change your hero’s Health characteristic to 7, change their Save characteristic to 3+ and replace their melee weapon with the following:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Great Blight Weapon
Crit (Mortal) | 5 | 3+ | 3+ | 1 | 2
Plague Daemon
-4DP
Your hero has the DAEMON and WARD (5+) keywords and the following regiment options:
Regiment Options | Any MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE DAEMON units
In addition, replace your hero’s melee weapon with the following:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Pestilential Weapon
Crit (Mortal) | 3 | 3+ | 3+ | 1 | 2
Tainted Mage
-4DP
Your hero has the ROTBRINGERS and WIZARD (1) keywords and the following regiment options:
Regiment Options | Any ROTBRINGERS units
Sorcerer of Sickness
-6DP
Your hero has the DAEMON, WIZARD (1) and WARD (5+) keywords and the following regiment options:
Regiment Options | Any MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE DAEMON units

sections.name: Step 4 - Pick Your Hero's Origin And/Or Flaw
sections.text: You can pick up to 1 origin and up to 1 flaw for your hero. Each adds an ability to your hero’s warscroll. However, instead of costing destiny points, flaws give you extra destiny points to spend elsewhere.

sections.name: Origins
sections.text:
Passive
-2DP
DISTENDED GUT
Effect: Add 7 to this unit’s control score while it is contesting an objective you do not control.
Passive
-4DP
SCABROUS SECOND HIDE
Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of ranged weapons used for shooting attacks that target this unit.
Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared a FIGHT ability for a unit in combat, with this unit
-4DP
PROJECTILE VOMITER
Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for that unit’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.
Passive
-5DP
ROOTED IN BLIGHTED SOIL
Effect: If this unit has not been set up this battle round and has not moved this battle round, it has WARD (4+).

sections.name: Flaws
sections.text:
Passive
+2DP
BOILS AND CYSTS
Effect: Subtract 1 from run rolls and charge rolls for this unit.
Passive
+2DP
NON-CONTAGIOUS
Effect: Enemy units in combat with this unit cannot be picked to be the targets of the ‘Blessed by the Plaguefather’ ability.
Passive
+4DP
HEALTHY CONSTITUTION
Effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for this unit.
Passive
+5DP
SLOW TO REACT
Effect: This unit has STRIKE-LAST.

sections.name: Step 5 - Choose a Battle Mount
sections.text:
You can pick up to 1 Battle Mount for your hero.
Battle Mount
-5DP
ROT FLY: This insectoid horror is a fitting mount for a champion of decay, striking swiftly on putrid wings before lunging with its venomous mandibles and stinger.
Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Rot Fly’s Mouthparts and Sting
Companion | 6 | 4+ | 3+ | - | 1
In addition, make the following changes to your hero’s warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 8".
Change the Health characteristic to 8.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the following keywords: CAVALRY, FLY.
Battle Mount
-15DP
POX MAGGOTH: Only true paragons of contagion ride hulking pox maggoths to war. To be blessed with such a monstrous beast is a potent mark of Nurgle’s favour.
Add the following weapon and ability to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Pox Maggoth’s Claws
Companion | 5 | 4+ | 2+ | 2 | 3
Passive
BATTLE DAMAGED Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Pox Maggoth’s Claws is 3.
In addition, make the following changes to your hero’s warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 8".
Change the Health characteristic to 14.
Change the Save characteristic to 4+.
Change the Control characteristic to 5.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the MONSTER keyword.

sections.name: Step 6 - Pick any Battle Mount Upgrades
sections.text:
If your hero has a Battle Mount, you can pick any number of Battle Mount Upgrades for them. The same upgrade cannot be picked more than once.
Upgrade | Effect
Droning Wings
-2DP
If your hero is a MONSTER, your hero has FLY.
If your hero is CAVALRY, add 2" to your hero’s Move characteristic.
Immense Rot Fly
-3DP
CAVALRY only. Add 2" to your hero’s Move characteristic.
Snotshower Sneeze
-3DP
Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
RANGED WEAPONS | Rng | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Snotshower Sneeze
Crit (2 Hits), Companion | 10" | 7 | 3+ | 3+ | 1 | 1
Corrosive to the Touch
-5DP
MONSTER only. Add the following ability to your hero’s warscroll. You cannot pick this upgrade if your hero has another RAMPAGE ability.
Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
CORROSIVE TO THE TOUCH
Declare: Pick an enemy non-MONSTER unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
KEYWORDS | RAMPAGE
Monstrous Belch
-5DP
MONSTER only. Add the following ability to your hero’s warscroll. You cannot pick this u your hero has another RAMPAGE ability.
Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
MONSTROUS BELCH
Declare: Pick an enemy MONSTER in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
KEYWORDS | RAMPAGE
Bileslime Drool

Add the following ability to your hero’s warscroll:
End of Your Turn

Declare: Pick D3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets. You cannot pick a Manifestation or terrain feature.
Effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 4+, the target has the DISEASED keyword.

sections.text:
Pick any number of other upgrades for your hero. The same upgrade cannot be picked more than once.

Fly Wings

sections.name: Path of Rancidity
sections.text:
(MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE HERO only)
ASPIRING: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
BLOATED AND BRUTAL
Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.
Passive
FOUL STENCH
Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy non-HERO units while they are in combat with this unit.
ELITE: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
End of Any Turn
IRREPRESSIBLE MOMENTUM
Effect: If this unit is in combat, it can make a pile-in move.
Reaction: Opponent declared a RETREAT ability for a unit in combat with this unit
OOZY
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll after the RETREAT ability has been resolved.
MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Deployment Phase
AFFLICTED IN ARMS
Declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.
Effect: For the rest of the battle, each time the target uses a command, after resolving that command or the ability it was a reaction to, Heal (D3) this unit.
Any Movement Phase
VISCOUS PHLEGM
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 3 from charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Once Per Battle, End of Your Turn
RISEN FROM DISEASE
Declare: This unit can only use this ability if it has been destroyed. Pick this unit to be the target, then pick a DISEASED enemy HERO to be the incubator.
Effect: You and your opponent must roll off. Add the targets Control characteristic to your roll and add the incubator’s Control characteristic to your opponent’s roll. If your roll equals or exceeds your opponent’s, set up a replacement unit for the target with 4 damage points allocated to it within 3" of the incubator. Then, if your roll is at least double your opponent’s, the incubator is automatically destroyed.
Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
THE FOULNESS THAT LURKS WITHIN
Declare: Pick each DISEASED enemy unit on the battlefield to be the targets.
Effect: The targets have STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

sections.name: Path of the Foetid Disciples
sections.text:
(non-HERO MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE unit only)
ASPIRING: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
REPULSIVE GRINS
Effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for enemy units while they are within 7" of this unit.
Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a SHOOT ability
MILDEW-ENCRUSTED
Effect: Ignore the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks made as part of that SHOOT ability.
ELITE: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
LOATHSOME FORTITUDE
Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s attacks while each model in this unit is contesting an objective.
Any Charge Phase
HORRIFIC MUTATIONS
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2-5, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. On a 6, inflict 2 mortal damage on the target.
MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
CONTAGIOUS TO LIVING MAGIC
Effect: Enemy MANIFESTATIONS cannot be set up within 12" of this unit and cannot pass through or end a move within this unit’s combat range unless they started that move within this unit’s combat range.
Passive
REEK OF MEDIOCRITY
Effect: Other than the Companion weapon ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target this unit have no effect.
LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick l of the following abilities for them:
Any Combat Phase
GRASPING TENTACLES
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Move characteristic, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
Passive
MIMETIC PARASITES
Effect: Each time an enemy unit in combat with this unit uses the ' All-out Defence' or ' All-out Attack' command, the effect of that command also applies to this unit for the rest of the phase.
